free_tier.stated: Free: 5 build credits a day, capped at 30 a month, so the cap is spent in the first 6 days of each calendar month; Pro starts at USD 25 a month for 100 credits, plus 5 daily build credits with no monthly cap
free_tier.notes: a credit is not a fixed unit of work: each message is charged on the work done, so the 30 free credits buy a variable number of messages

record.interface_detail: a web app where a prompt builds a project. Git sync with GitHub, GitLab and Bitbucket is on every plan. The Lovable REST API at api.lovable.dev/v1 (Lovable-API-Key header, keys start lov_) manages and deploys existing projects, needs a Business or higher plan, and spends no build credits. AI project creation and editing run through the Lovable MCP server, which is open to every plan and spends the same credits as the web app
record.tooling: hosted service with a web editor; no local client is documented. An MCP client such as Claude or Cursor can drive project creation and messages through the MCP server on any plan
record.chaining: Pro, USD 25 a month for 100 credits (USD 250 a year), adds code editing and download, custom domains and credit rollover; the Lovable API needs Business, whose 100-credit tier is USD 50 a month. Plan mode costs 1 credit a message; Build mode messages are priced by the work done, from 0.50 credits for a one-line style change to 1.70 for a landing page with 3 generated images. Chat messages usually cost a fraction of a credit and draw first on a separate daily chat allowance of unpublished size
